testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cancel a staged model-state parameter column and value ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the user creates an undimensioned rectangular sketch and extrudes it 1 in with zero taper ✔ And the user creates model states Capture State and Copy State and activates Copy State ✔ And The MCAD Software has a part with three model-state members ✔ And an extrusion has a length parameter d0 of 1 in ✔ And the model-state table does not include d0 ✔ And Copy State is active ✔ When the user opens the model-state table ✔ And selects d0 under the extrusion on the Parameters tab ✔ And transfers d0 to the chosen parameters ✔ Then the chosen parameters include d0 ✔ And the grid has a d0 column showing 1 in for each member ✔ When the user changes the Copy State d0 cell to 2 in ✔ Then that cell displays 2 in ✔ And the other two d0 cells display 1 in ✔ When the user cancels and reopens the model-state table ✔ Then d0 is absent from the chosen parameters ✔ And the grid has no d0 column
